is_anopheles.evidence: The study evaluated bed nets against wild free-flying Anopheles gambiae s.s. (largely An. coluzzii) in experimental huts (page 1, 2).

reports_target_markers.evidence: No genotyping was performed in this study. The paper only mentions Vgsc L1014F (misprinted as L104F) by citing a previous study (Koffi et al. 2013, reference [9]) for the baseline resistance characteristics of the M'Bé site (page 2).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No mosquitoes from this trial were genotyped; no genotype or allele counts/frequencies were measured or presented.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were free-flying wild mosquitoes entering experimental huts in M'bé, Côte d'Ivoire (page 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research article reporting an experimental hut trial conducted in 2012 (page 1, 4).

sub_country_location.evidence: Huts were located in M'bé, 30 km north of Bouaké (5.209963 W and 7.970241 N), central Côte d'Ivoire (page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquito collections were carried out between October 8 and November 3, 2012 (page 4).

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the efficacy of Olyset Duo bed nets against wild pyrethroid-resistant Anopheles gambiae s.l. in experimental huts in M'bé, Côte d'Ivoire. No molecular genotyping of resistance markers was conducted as part of this study; previous publications were cited for the site's resistance profile.
